q1_issues.issue: `(Past sk_stage_1)` tenses a participial reduced relative ("others staged near …"), but tense atoms are licensed on finite clauses only — a participial reduced relative tenses nothing.

`(Past sk_others_1)` applies a status predicate to a group entity (`GroupOf sk_others_1 attack`) rather than to an eventuality or a categorical atom, and it duplicates the tense already carried by the staging event.

q2_gaps: past-tense "seemed" — the seem/appear rule routes the clause to a bare epistemic status on the complement, leaving no carrier for the matrix verb's own past tense (the no-tense-beside-an-epistemic rule is written for tense-neutral present modals)
"others" (contrastive plural) — distinctness from the antecedent attack has no licensed carrier
notes: "seemed" correctly takes the epistemic route with no perception event reified, and `(Similar …)` + `(Symmetric Similar)` matches the symmetric-predicate rule; `foreign_compound` fusion with genus and modifier atoms in the group's kind slot is also per doctrine. Attaching "in Riyadh" to the compounds rather than to the staging is a world-knowledge lean, which the instruction set treats as a single reading rather than an Interpretation split.
